In Open Darkroom, open Settings → Debug → Logs and press **Copy diagnostics**, then paste the result below. If the app no longer starts, attach the newest files from the log folder instead:

- macOS: `~/Library/Logs/com.Layshoo.open-darkroom/`
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\com.Layshoo.open-darkroom\logs\`
